content:
Following the "Surprise and Shine" event held in September, Apple immediately released the RC (Release Candidate) versions of systems including iPadOS 27 and watchOS 27.

Starting today, RC versions including iPadOS 27 are available for testing.

The major new software updates Apple has prepared for iPhone, iPad, Mac and other devices are about to launch.

iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, tvOS 27 and visionOS 27 will be officially released to all users next Monday (September 14).

After a full summer of beta testing, Apple today officially released the RC versions of the aforementioned updates.

Developers and public beta testers can install the RC versions including iPadOS 27 through the "Software Update" screen in "Settings".

The Release Candidate version is theoretically the final software version to be released to all users. However, if Apple discovers any significant issues that need to be fixed, we may see an RC 2 released within a short period of time.

Apple has always had the practice of launching the RC versions of brand new major software right after the annual iPhone event concludes.

The reason is that some new features not announced at WWDC are often saved for the September event to be unveiled. For example, Apple detailed some watchOS 27 changes at today's Apple Watch hardware launch event — content never mentioned in June — which can now be tried out in the watchOS 27 RC.

Have you discovered any new features in Apple's RC versions? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
